annotations.title: Check contrast for many color pairs at once

description: Use when the user has a whole design system, theme or stylesheet and wants every text and background pair checked for accessibility in one go. Takes up to 50 pairs and returns the ratio and AA and AAA results for each, with a count of failures. Example: {"pairs": [{"foreground": "#777", "background": "#fff", "label": "muted text"}, {"foreground": "#fff", "background": "#ff5a1f", "label": "button"}]}.

label.description: Optional name, like "muted text on card".

name: swatch_check_pairs
